title: Squat jump: stand, squat, jump, land
tagline: The final run: a policy rewarded for completing the squat jump's stages in order, without falling. Results appear here when training finishes.

story.shown: The squat-jump phone video: two countermovement jumps.
story.learned: Training on an A100: a policy rewarded for the stages, not for matching the clip frame by frame.
story.how: Stage completion, falls and jump height, judged on the robot's own body.
